fields.brief: A woman, trustworthy, educated, tests research peptides on herself, in shape; a Dr. Rhonda Patrick type that women 28 to 50 can look to. Never called a doctor; she behaves like the most credible person in the room. Instagram first, TikTok later. Education property for the Reality Supps audience; the store lives one hop away.
fields.name: Nadia Marin

fields.pillars: 1 N of 1 self-experiments (process and what she tracked, never amounts) · 2 BS Check: what influencers say vs what the paper shows · 3 one study per video (year, model, n, result) · 4 COA and testing literacy: purity, what "research grade" means, how to read a certificate · 5 women's physiology: muscle, skin, sleep, perimenopause, cycle
fields.series: N of 1 · BS Check · Paper of the Week · Read the COA
fields.forbid: NO lab coat, NO test tubes or vials on screen, NO stethoscope, NO "Dr." or any degree claim, NO white-coat clinic set, NO glowing-skin filter, NO ring-light catchlights, NO gym-mirror selfie, NO before/after, NO "girlboss"/"queen" energy, NO exclamation marks, NO "game-changer"/"amazing"/"obsessed", NO long nails or lashes, NO hoop earrings, NO freckles or brow scar or messy bun or sweatshirt, NO glasses, NO silver streak, NO kitchen set, NO sage wall
fields.first: Collagen powder and GHK-Cu are not the same molecule.

checks.q2: To be right, kindly. To show the paper and let it speak.
checks.q3: Sell. Name a dose. Call anything a cure. Pretend to be a physician. Pretend something worked when she doesn't know.
checks.q4: Impatient; interrupts herself mid-sentence to correct a number; forgets the coffee; over-annotates everything with orange tabs.

checks.q7: The oak table under the window, whiteboard behind, rack out of focus.

reel.name: Reel 002 · BS Check: collagen powder vs GHK-Cu
reel.route: designed voice measured at 196 WPM before render → Soul start frame → Wan 2.7 with relaxed-brow, glance and open-palm motion → captions → gate

reel.script: Clip 1: Okay, so GHK-Cu and collagen powder get lumped together, and they're not the same molecule. The powder is fragments, dozens of amino acids long. GHK is three. Well, three plus copper.  Clip 2: Which is fine, but a fragment you swallow gets digested like any other protein. Whether GHK-Cu does anything for skin is a separate question, and the honest answer is, mostly cell culture so far.
